audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side read "Skill" on all seven rows while content win[] and the packet chart both read Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Cassiopeia x4. The full layer and content layer disagreed on every row.
audit.why: Cassiopeia's early pattern is Noxious Blast alone at 850 range with almost no auto range; Neeko out-trades until level 3. From level 4 the Q-into-Twin-Fang chain ramps, Miasma grounds at 24s rank 1, and Petrifying Gaze stuns anything facing her.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 to Neeko, rows 3-6 to Cassiopeia, with the whys for rows 3-6 rewritten to describe her winning them.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes credited Neeko at 3, 6 and first item; the level 4 ramp that actually decides the lane was absent.
audit.why: Twin Fang is a 0.75s cooldown that deals increased damage to poisoned targets and heals her; once she has ranks in it the trade inverts permanently. Petrifying Gaze at level 6 ends face-up engages.
audit.corrected: Level 3 root-bloom is your only kill window; her E ramp at 4 flips it; her R ends face-up fights.
sources: enemyKit E cd 0.75 and heal flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Miasma "grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it" but never connected it to Pop Blossom, carried no cooldown number, and never mentioned the Petrifying Gaze facing rule at all.
audit.why: From the kits: Miasma grounds (24/22/20/18/16, 700 range), and Neeko's R is flagged as a leap, so grounding denies it. Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her and merely slows enemies with their back turned — that is the single most actionable line in her kit for a Neeko flanking from a disguise. Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of damage dealt, which is the anti-heal trigger the missing-interactions file flags.
audit.corrected: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and grounds Pop Blossom; approach from behind so Petrifying Gaze only slows; buy Oblivion Orb because Twin Fang heals her.
sources: enemyKit W grounding flag and cd

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (defect catalogue item 3).
audit.why: Miasma at 24s rank 1 is the longest and most punishable cooldown in the lane; Noxious Blast at 3.5s means her poke never actually runs out, which is why waiting for "a poke window" is wrong advice.
audit.corrected: Numbers added for Miasma, Noxious Blast and Neeko's E.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t said "Add anti-heal early into his sustain" — wrong gender and no item named (defect catalogue item 7).
audit.why: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of damage dealt; Oblivion Orb is the actual early component.
audit.corrected: Add Oblivion Orb early: Twin Fang heals her.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pronoun defect (catalogue item 1): Cassiopeia is female but the full layer called her "he/his/him" in tradeGood, breakdown.trading, ahead, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].t, report[3].t, report[8].t, report[9].t and report[11].t. Copy-paste bleed (item 2) in dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d, which were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings verbatim.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists cassiopeia as female; the owner is addressed as "you", so every third-person pronoun on the page refers to her.
audit.corrected: All pronouns corrected to she/her and the two bled bodies replaced with content matching their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.suspectNames flags "Twin Fangs" in the content mid paragraph; the ability is Twin Fang, singular.
audit.why: packet.enemyAbilities.E is "Twin Fang" and the kit file agrees.
audit.corrected: "chain Twin Fangs efficiently" -> "chain Twin Fang efficiently".

notes: Two systemic defects fixed here: the full layer misgendered Cassiopeia in ten fields, and phases[].side was "Skill" across the board while content win[] already matched the packet (Neeko x3, Cassiopeia x4). No win[] edits were needed. One correction beyond the brief: the content mid paragraph claimed Miasma cuts off "your W Shapesplitter escape" — Shapesplitter sends a clone and is not a movement ability, so grounding does not deny it; Pop Blossom's leap is what Miasma actually denies, and that is what the rewrite says. suspectNames "Twin Fangs" corrected to Twin Fang in the same string.
